blocks.text: Thermoregulation homeostasis (andar ke halaat ko ek jaisa rakhna) ki ek qism hai jis mein jandar bahar ka temperature badalne ke bawajood apne jism ka temperature qaim rakhte hain. Zyada temperature enzymes ko denature kar deta hai (yani un ki shakal bigar deta hai, aur woh kaam karna chhor dete hain) aur metabolism ko nuqsan pohnchata hai. Pode garmi se bachne ke liye evaporative cooling (pani ke bhaap ban kar urne se thandak) istemal karte hain. Lekin garam aur khushk mausam mein pani ki kami ho jati hai jis se stomata band ho jate hain, is liye aise halaat mein pode takleef uthate hain. Zyada tar pode garmi ke dabao (heat stress) mein zinda rehne ke liye dhal gaye hain, kyun ke temperate (mo'tadil) ilaqon ke podon ko bhi 40°C aur us se zyada temperature ka samna karna parta hai. Aise podon ke cells khaas proteins bari miqdar mein banate hain jinhen heat-shock proteins kehte hain. Yeh proteins enzymes aur doosre proteins ko apne ghere mein le kar unhen denature hone se bachate hain.

Doosri taraf kam temperature cell membrane ki rawani (fluidity) badal deta hai, kyun ke membrane ke lipids jam kar crystal jaisi banawaton mein phans jate hain; is se solutes ka andar bahar jana mutasir hota hai. Membrane proteins ki banawat bhi mutasir hoti hai. Pode thand ke dabao (cold stress) ka jawab yun dete hain ke membrane mein unsaturated fatty acids ka hissa barha dete hain; yeh crystals bannay se rok kar kam temperature par bhi membrane ki banawat qaim rakhte hain. Is tabdeeli mein waqt lagta hai. Isi liye achanak thand (rapid chilling) podon ke liye hawa ke temperature ke aahista aahista girne se zyada nuqsan-deh hai. Jamane wala (freezing) temperature barf ke crystal banata hai. Agar barf sirf cell wall ke gird bane to itna nuqsan nahin hota aur poda bach jata hai. Lekin agar protoplasm (cell ke zinda hisse) ke andar barf ke crystal ban jayen to woh membranes aur organelles mein surakh kar dete hain aur cells mar jate hain. Thande ilaqon ke pode, jaise oak, maple, gulab aur doosre pode, apne cells ke solutes ki tarkeeb badal lete hain. Is se cytosol barf bane baghair zero se neeche thanda ho sakta hai (super cool), halaanke cell walls mein barf ke crystal ban sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Achanak pala (frost) aik pode ko kyun maar deta hai, jab ke wohi temperature aahista aahista aaye to poda bach jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Thand se bachao mein waqt lagta hai: pode ko membrane mein unsaturated fatty acids barhane hote hain taake lipids crystal na banein, aur solutes badalne hote hain taake cytosol super cool ho sake. Aahista thand mein yeh tabdeeliyan ho jati hain; achanak thand mein nahin hotin, is liye membrane jam jati hai aur protoplasm ke andar barf ban kar cells ko maar sakti hai.

items: Garmi enzymes ko denature karti hai; pode evaporative cooling aur heat-shock proteins se bachte hain (temperate podon ko bhi 40°C ya zyada ka samna hota hai).

Thand membrane lipids ko crystal bana deti hai; pode unsaturated fatty acids barhate hain magar aahista, is liye achanak thand zyada nuqsan-deh hai. Freezing mein protoplasm ke andar barf cells ko maarti hai; thande ilaqon ke pode (oak, maple, gulab) solutes badal kar cytosol ko super cool karte hain.
